A head published between the two reads followed by a snapshot/store failure is masked. The proposed acceptance tests do not distinguish that race from a legitimate absent head.

Add deterministic absent-precheck/failed-snapshot MCP list and Invoke tests asserting host error and zero Dispatch, alongside true absent-head and absent-then-success controls. Apply a mutation restoring the current catch-all and prove the selected new test kills it.
